messages.content: 在一場撲克遊戲中，確定贏家是誰，約翰手中有8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥，邁克手中有9♠、J♠、10♠、Q♠、K♠。

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content:
在這兩手牌中，兩位玩家都拿到了一手 **同花**（都是五張同一花色的牌），但並沒有順子。  
比較同花的牌面大小時，從最大牌往下比：

| 牌序 | 約翰 | 邁克 |
|------|------|------|
| K    | ✔️   | ✔️   |
| Q    | ✔️   | ✔️   |
| J    | ✔️   | ✔️   |
| 10   | ✔️   | ✔️   |
| 8/9  | 8♥  | 9♠  |

兩人前四張牌完全相同，最後一張牌決定勝負。邁克手中的 9♠ 大於約翰手中的 8♥，因此邁克贏得這一局。
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush from 8 to K? Actually 8-10-J-Q-K is a straight flush (8-9-10-J-Q-K? Wait missing 9♥). He has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's not a straight flush because missing 9♥. It's a flush (all hearts) but not straight. It's a flush of hearts with high card K. Mike has 9♠,J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠. That's also a flush of spades, missing 8♠. So both have flushes. Compare high cards: both have K, Q, J, 10. John's highest is K, same. Next is Q, same. Next J, same. Next 10, same. Next 8 vs 9. Mike has 9, John has 8. So Mike wins. So answer: Mike wins.
